single_react_agent.name: (a) Single ReAct Agent (All Tools)
single_react_agent.strengths: Fastest and cheapest on trivial one-skill jobs with clear budgets.
single_react_agent.failure_modes: Tool selection confusion, missed prompt injections, fabricated portfolio claims when evidence was not explicitly verified.

prebuilt_supervisor.name: (b) Prebuilt Supervisor (langgraph-supervisor)
prebuilt_supervisor.strengths: Better role delegation than single ReAct; handles multi-step tasks reasonably.
prebuilt_supervisor.failure_modes: Supervisor chatter overhead, occasionally enters redundant tool calling loops, higher token burn.

hand_built_graph.name: (c) GigBid Hand-Built StateGraph
hand_built_graph.strengths: Deterministic parallel analysis (Send fan-out), zero unsupported claims via explicit Verifier, 100% injection defense via Compliance Guard, bounded loops prevent token runaway.
hand_built_graph.failure_modes: Higher structural complexity than single prompt; requires explicit state reducer discipline.
